suiteFeedDecision.newDecisivelyBeatsOldExplanation: Yes. The round-two engine decisively beats the old engine in concept specificity, hierarchy, visual craft, brand atmosphere, communication, polish, and feed variety. That relative win is not professional approval: no current asset reaches 145, and slide 10 has a hard failure.

observations: The feed now has materially better silhouette diversity across macro material, dark editorial, photography, information reduction, announcement identity, and evidence architecture.
Deep green, pale mineral, and one charged accent create recognizable continuity without forcing every tile into the same upper-headline and lower-object template.
The flat-vector group still shares a narrow rail-and-node vocabulary, while 03, 07, and 12 do not pass their textless mechanism tests and 10 contains a visible production defect.
The three-by-three view has a credible rhythm of material, editorial, data, photography, and announcement beats rather than the round-one split between repeated cinematic heroes and flat posters.
Tile 05 creates a valuable human and photographic counterweight, while 01 and 02 remain sufficiently separated in crop and depth.
Several tiles still depend on palette and typography for cohesion more than on equally resolved, message-specific mechanisms.
The sequence now progresses visibly from locating a decision, through defining boundaries, to a human stop, with alternating field density and clear RTL action.
Slide 09 opens with an asymmetric selected-versus-rejected fork and slide 11 closes with a real manual obstruction rather than repeating one cover layout.
Slide 10's clipped Arabic glyph is a typography hard failure in the middle of the narrative, so the three-slide carousel cannot be presented as professional in its current pixels.
05 reads as many strands becoming one output and is the successful restart mechanism.

03 reads as a precision fixture rather than a custody transfer, 07 reads as premium stationery rather than inseparable provenance, and 12 reads as a generic network under a glass band rather than a precise answer plane.

preciseRevisionPriorities: Correct the visible Arabic glyph clipping and panel alignment in 10 first; the new raster must receive a new hash and fresh original, mobile, and carousel inspection.
Give 01 a final contact-material pass and 05 a final hands-strands-clamp pass; these are the closest candidates at 144 and 143, but neither may be rounded into professional status.
Apply bounded revisions to 02, 04, 08, 09, and 11 without expanding their copy or adding decorative state signals.
Restart the central textless mechanisms for 03, 07, and 12; do not rescue the current fixture, stationery, or generic-network readings with labels, arrows, or glow.
Deepen 06's four-to-one state change beyond a numeral-and-arrow explanation while preserving its excellent mobile comprehension.
After any pixel change, invalidate this review and rerun exact-hash art-direction, graphic-design, Arabic, social-performance, feed, and carousel critiques.

overallVerdict.summary: Round two is a substantial and decisive improvement over the old engine, and the feed now looks like a coherent premium system rather than a repeated template. It is still below the defined professional bar: the highest independent score is 144, no asset reaches 145, three restarted mechanisms fail textless comprehension, and slide 10 contains a visible typography hard failure.
overallVerdict.releasePosition: No professional or release claim is supported by this senior-art-director review.
